To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We propose a parallel sampling scheme to reconstruct the amplitudes of UWB impulses from the outputs of cascaded identical RC lowpass filters.

(1) the parallel sampling of cascaded identical analog RC filters is an effective approach to reconstructing the amplitudes of the p sequential impulses; (2) the parallel sampling scheme can be used to measure the UWB impulse; (3) the parallel sampling method can be easily implemented in VLSI.
we have presented a new method for reconstruction of UWB impulse train by parallel sampling of cascaded identical RC Filters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and analysis of the parallel sampling method of the cascaded RC filters.
the development of a novel parallel sampling scheme for the reconstruction of UWB impulse train.
the reconstruction of the UWB impulses by parallel sampling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the parallel sampling method is a simple and effective approach for reconstruction of the impulse train from its sampled outputs.
the parallel sampling scheme provides a new method for UWB impulse train measurement and it can be implemented in VLSI technology.
the parallel sampling scheme can be used to measure the UWB impulse trains with high precision and accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new parallel sampling technique that can be used for the measurement of the ultra wide band (UWB) pulses.

the parallel sampling scheme can reconstruct the UWB impulse trains by sampling a small portion of the impulse trains and the reconstructed UWB impulse trains have a good agreement with the original UWB impulse trains in both the time and frequency domain.
the parallel sampling scheme can be used to detect the UWB impulses and reconstruct the amplitudes of the impulses from the outputs of cascaded identical RC filter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the UWB impulse can be measured by a single analog circuitry with the parallel sampling of cascaded RC filters.
the reconstruction of UWB impulse train is possible by sampling of the cascades identical RC filters.
we have developed an efficient parallel sampling scheme to measure the time locations and amplitudes of UWB impulse train.
